Hi Alicia / Samir —

Great to meet with you both today — thanks for the time and the candid background on the fraud detection workflows. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Recap: You run near‑real time scoring on transaction streams (~50k TPS peak), care deeply about P99 latency under 150ms, and need a private deployment option for regulated data.
- Next step: Technical deep dive / demo where our platform team can walk through latency/throughput tuning, KV cache behavior, and VPC/private deployment architecture.

Proposed windows (PT):
- Tue Aug 11: 10:00–11:00am PT
- Wed Aug 12: 9:00–10:00am PT

Can you confirm which works and whether we should include Procurement (Lindsey) and any additional platform/security folks? If you confirm Wed 9am PT, I’ll loop in our SE (Dev Patel) and Solutions lead (Stephanie Nguyen) and send a calendar invite plus a short prep deck.

Attaching: redwood-demo-deck.pdf — brief outline for the session.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Solutions, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Note: I can also share a short HubSpot mutual action plan if helpful (will include the link in the follow-up invite).

Thanks Marissa — great recap. Wed 9:00–10:00am PT works best for the FinPath team.

A few notes from our side before the deep dive:
- Security wants a more detailed session on data handling (KV cache, retention, encryption at rest/in transit). I’ve looped in Samir (security) above.
- Procurement (Lindsey) should be on the call to start discussing contract timing and any standard terms.

I’m attaching our security questionnaire (FinPath-Security-Questionnaire.pdf) — Samir will start filling it out but please send over any SOC2, data retention, and KMS/HSM docs you have ready.

If Wed at 9am is confirmed, please go ahead and send the invite with the agenda + attendee list.

Best,

- Please be prepared to discuss SOC 2 scope and recent report availability (we’ll need to see the report as part of procurement).
- Data retention and deletion flows for KV caches — specifically how long prefixes/keys are retained and where they are stored.
- KMS/HSM integrations and the contact we’d speak to about key rotation and customer-managed keys.

We’ll start filling out the attached questionnaire and aim to return it by Friday. If you can pre-send any SOC2 redacted pdf + a short architecture doc on KMS integration that would speed things up.
